claim: Cryptographic operations on KMS keys in one external key store count toward a request quota of 1800 requests per second for that key store by default; the custom key store quota table marks this quota as not adjustable.

qualifiers.condition: the same page's text says all KMS request quotas except the AWS CloudHSM key store quota are adjustable and mentions adjusting the external key store request quota; the table says No

evidence.quote: Requests for cryptographic operations on KMS keys in a custom key store also count toward a `Custom key store request quota` of 1,800 operations per second.
All AWS KMS request quotas are adjustable, except for the AWS CloudHSM key store request quota.

note: source tension: the table marks the external key store request quota not adjustable, while the intro sentence and the ExternalKeyStoreThrottle note imply it can be adjusted; the claim states only what the table says.
